questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.question_stem: The smallest 3 digit prime number is
questions.solution_rationale: The smallest 3 digit number is 100, which is divisible by 2. 101 is not divisible by 2, 3, 5, and 7. Therefore, 101 is a prime number.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.question_stem: If x and y are coprime, their HCF is:
questions.solution_rationale: By definition, two numbers are coprime if their highest common factor (HCF) is exactly 1.
